A few years ago, during my braces treatment, I had an X-ray taken which showed a cyst near my left wisdom tooth, but unfortunately, this was not detected or informed to me by the previous dentist at that time. Even after visiting another dentist later and getting another X-ray due to pain, I was only advised wisdom tooth removal and was still not informed about the presence of a cyst.

When I finally consulted Dr. Aaditi Mahajan, she advised a 3D CBCT scan, after which she clearly detected a cyst associated with my left wisdom tooth. She took the time to explain my condition in detail and patiently discussed all possible complications, including the risk of temporary numbness and delayed healing. I truly appreciated her transparent and honest approach.

Since the case was complicated, I took nearly three months to decide. During Diwali, I finally went ahead with the surgery. The procedure itself was completely painless—I only felt mild pressure during the surgery. The recovery was surprisingly smooth; within 2 days, I was comfortable, and within 2 weeks, I felt almost normal.

I did experience some post-surgical numbness, but Dr. Aaditi had already explained this possibility beforehand. With proper follow-ups and care, the numbness gradually reduced and completely resolved over time. By December, I was about 90% back to normal, and now I feel as good as I did before the treatment.

Overall, my experience at Loop Dental was excellent—from diagnosis to treatment and recovery. If you are looking for wisdom tooth removal, especially in complicated cases, I would highly recommend Dr. Aaditi Mahajan and Loop Dental, Chembur. You are truly in safe and experienced hands.
